# `lear demo` effect registry

<!-- generated by scripts/gen_demo_effects_doc.py from lear-demo-effects-v2; do not edit by hand -->

Registry **`lear-demo-effects-v2`**: **118 recipes** in **40 families**, built from **31 layouts** (what is drawn) and **11 motions** (how it arrives). **66** recipes are wired into scenes S00-S11; the other 52 are available to `lear demo effects --preview <id>` and to future scenes, and are drawn from labelled example data there.

Source: [`ragformation/lear/demo_effects.py`](../../ragformation/lear/demo_effects.py). List: `python3 -m ragformation lear demo effects` (`--json` for the full record of every field). Preview: `python3 -m ragformation lear demo effects --preview <id>[,<id>...]` or `--preview all` ([`evidence/demo/effects_preview_plain.txt`](evidence/demo/effects_preview_plain.txt)).

## What counts as a recipe

- A recipe is **one real event drawn one way**: a unique `purpose` (the real value it shows) and a unique `(layout, motion, purpose)` triple. Colour-only or speed-only variants do not count, and the registry test fails on a duplicate id, purpose or triple (`EffectRegistryTests`).
- **The static form is the final frame.** With motion off (`--plain`, `--no-animate`, `--speed 0`, non-TTY, `CI`, `NO_COLOR`, `TERM=dumb`) every recipe prints exactly the lines its animation ends on. `test_static_form_is_the_final_frame_of_the_animated_form` checks this for all recipes, and bounds the frame count.
- **No invented values.** A recipe draws only the data it is handed. Typing is reserved for a real model stream (`answer_stream` with `realStream`); extractive baseline output prints at once (`test_typing_is_reserved_for_a_real_model_stream`).
- **Correction to the previous version.** The v1 guide claimed 36 effects; the code had 20 distinct motion methods. This registry replaces it; see [demo_production_audit.md](demo_production_audit.md).

## Contract shared by every recipe

| Field | Value |
|---|---|
| interrupt | interruptible between frames; Ctrl-C ends the demo with exit 130 after an ANSI reset |
| noColour | same text without ANSI styles |
| cleanup | each frame ends with erase-to-end-of-line; styles are closed per line; the cursor is never hidden |
| seed | deterministic: no randomness |
| test | tests/test_lear_demo.py::EffectRegistryTests |
| terminal | motion needs a TTY, --speed > 0 and no --plain/--no-animate/CI; otherwise static / motion needs a TTY, --speed > 0 and no --plain/--no-animate/CI; otherwise static; needs colour |

## Motions (how it arrives)

| Motion | Timing at `--speed 1` | Mechanism | Recipes |
|---|---|---|---|
| `count` | 7 frames x 30 ms, numbers scale 1/8..8/8 | carriage-return redraw per line | 9 |
| `feed` | one line per 35 ms | lines printed one by one | 35 |
| `flap` | 6 deterministic digit frames x 40 ms | carriage-return redraw per line | 7 |
| `grow` | 7 frames x 30 ms per line | carriage-return redraw per line | 13 |
| `instant` | no motion | none | 33 |
| `scan` | one reverse-video pass, 30 ms per line | cursor-up redraw of <= 30 lines; needs colour | 1 |
| `settle` | arrival frame, then in-place reorder | cursor-up redraw of <= 30 lines | 1 |
| `stamp` | 1 placeholder frame x 80 ms | carriage-return redraw per line | 14 |
| `sweep` | 10 frames x 20 ms marker pass | carriage-return redraw per line | 1 |
| `type_input` | ~40 frames x 15 ms on the first line | single carriage-return line | 3 |
| `type_stream` | real stream only; otherwise instant | single carriage-return line | 1 |
